hook_text: Half a cake, two quarters, four eighths. Three different fractions, one slice of cake.
clip_script: A birthday in George. Zanele gets half the cake. Cut each half in two: now she has 2 quarters. Cut again: 4 eighths. Same cake on her plate. 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 are equivalent. The rule: multiply the top and bottom by the same number. 3/4 times 3 over 3 is 9/12. Simplify by dividing: 6/12 divided by 6 is 1/2. Which is bigger, 2/3 or 3/4? Change both to twelfths: 8/12 and 9/12. 3/4 wins. Never add to top and bottom: 1/2 is not 2/3. Cut smaller, same amount.
visual_style: One cake slice being recut into smaller pieces while a fraction label changes, with a fraction wall lining up beside it.
mood: Celebratory and clear, like cutting a birthday cake.
pacing: Cut, cut again, the rule, then the 2/3 versus 3/4 showdown.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three fractions equal to 1/3.
